# 08_Film-and-Paperwork (yellow style)

Posters, business card, email signature, letterhead, invoice, press kit, clapperboard and the 'presents' card.

## Folders

| Folder | What is in it |
|---|---|
| [`business-card/`](business-card/) | Business card, 90 x 55 mm. |
| [`clapperboard/`](clapperboard/) | The clapperboard: a transparent PNG (open and closed, 4096 and 1024 px), a still on the style's colour, and a 3 s clap with sound (MP4 on colour, and transparent ProRes 4444 to put over footage). |
| [`email-signature/`](email-signature/) |  |
| [`letterhead-and-invoice/`](letterhead-and-invoice/) | Letterhead and invoice template, A4 PDF and PNG. |
| [`posters/`](posters/) | One poster per film in films.txt, in two sizes: A3 at 300 dpi (3508 x 4961) and 2:3 (4000 x 6000). |
| [`presents-card/`](presents-card/) | 'ASTRIS PRODUCTIONS presents' as 4K stills and as 3 s animations with sound, on the main and the dark field. |
| [`press-kit/`](press-kit/) | Press kit: a one-page PDF and a five-page PDF, boilerplate.txt (yours to write), a downloads list, logo files, and page previews. |
